data.one_liner: Stricter analyzer lint rules used in Forus Labs' Dart & Flutter projects.
data.what_it_does: Flint provides an opinionated set of strict static analysis lints for Dart and Flutter projects. It is configured by adding it as a dev dependency and including the provided Dart or Flutter ruleset in an analysis_options.yaml file.
use_when: You want a strict set of analyzer lints beyond standard packages like flutter_lints.
You want separate rulesets tailored for pure Dart or Flutter projects.
avoid_when: You prefer looser or standard default lint configurations.
Your project cannot meet the strict constraints and rules enforced by Flint.
strengths: Stricter ruleset compared to standard lint packages.
Provides both Dart and Flutter specific rulesets.
weaknesses: May produce a large number of warnings or errors when introduced into legacy codebases.
Internal ruleset focus means rules change according to Forus Labs' preferences.
data.setup_notes: Add flint as a dev dependency and include either package:flint/analysis_options.dart.yaml or package:flint/analysis_options.flutter.yaml in your analysis_options.yaml file.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer the official, standard set of recommended lints for Flutter apps.

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer the official, standard set of recommended lints for Dart packages.

alternatives.name: analyzer
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want to write custom analyzer rules directly using the analyzer package.
